scope: Six separate VMs, one test administrator/dealer, private peering, no artificial RTT; proving and public verifier on Windows controller. No independent physical-hardware or DKG claim.
measurement_notes: Original manifests are preserved. Two n=8 controller worktrees were dirty only while EVM JavaScript was edited; all nodes ran the same clean f1281647 release binary. Rust protocol, Cargo.lock and ballot relation were unchanged.

Communication aggregates use actual Trustee CLI writer statistics and Board relay statistics. In f1281647, Board per-trustee upstream copies can include an extra internal 5-byte EOF notification; fixed by 07a81f8 with an endpoint-accounting regression. Original per-run metadata is not retroactively edited.

Trustee CLI sent bytes count POST and STATS frames; HELLO is sent separately and is excluded. Received bytes count ENTRY frames. Board relayed bytes count ENTRY frames to all five peers. These are application-frame metrics, not IP/TCP packet or link-layer totals.
